                                         ORDINANCE                              D-EC 14(2-02-2.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 2-K in the area bounded by:

              West Madison Street; a line 250.0 feet west of and parallel to South Keeler Avenue;
              the public alley next south of and parallel to West Madison Street; a line 300.8 feet
              west of and parallel to South Keeler Avenue

to those of an B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 4225-29 West Madison Street
